status: CONTRACT ONLY — conversation_engine.py is not modified in SB2A or SB2A-R2; SB2B wires these sites

sites.current_operation: Writes ThreadRevision(status='booked') and an occupying Revision at state.preferred_day/preferred_time, then self.db.commit(). No advisory lock, no revalidation, no calendar check, no professional, no idempotency; under SB1 an overlap raises 23P01 inside CE.

command.operation: CREATE (REQUEST_MANUAL_SCHEDULING, non-occupying, when the agreed slot is incomplete)
command.idempotency_key: ce-flow-response:<sha256('<thread_id>|token|<flow_token>')[:48]> | ce-flow-response:<sha256('<thread_id>|msg|<inbound wamid>')[:48]>; blank identities are never hashed
command.attach: writes the booked ThreadRevision + lead/state updates + token consumption; returns the ThreadRevision

sb2b_rules: COMMITTED/IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY: keep the flow-txn:<ThreadRevision.id> acknowledgement keyed on result.thread_revision_id
SLOT_CONFLICT/CALENDAR_EXCEPTION: book nothing; call request_manual_scheduling so the human escalation survives
any other refusal: book nothing, acknowledge nothing as confirmed, hand off
VALIDATION_FAILED/EVENT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED: book nothing; hand off — never retry with an invented identity
sites.identity_rule: flow_token, else ctx.inbound_wa_message_id; neither present (or blank) → VALIDATION_FAILED / EVENT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED, nothing written

sites.current_operation: Writes an OCCUPYING Revision (default PENDIENTE) at the time the customer insists on after CE judged it unavailable. Under SB1 an overlap raises 23P01, CE's catch-all rolls back the entire turn and returns action='error' (handled=True): no reply, and the escalation, needs_human and handoff e-mail are lost.

command.idempotency_key: ce-escalation:<sha256('<thread_id>|esc|<escalation_id>' | '<thread_id>|cycle|<cycle_key>' | '<thread_id>|msg|<inbound wamid>')[:48]>, first non-blank in that order
command.requested_slot: complete, date only, time only or neither — stored as given; the missing half is never invented

invariants: never PARTIAL_SLOT: a partial requested slot is accepted
the human escalation is preserved even when the requested slot is unavailable or incomplete
RETRYABLE_FAILURE/INTERNAL_FAILURE (lock timeout, schema preflight): SB2B must still escalate to a human without a CRM placeholder

session_contract: Each adapter call runs in its OWN short-lived session (isolated_session) and commits or rolls back only that session. The caller's session is never flushed, committed or rolled back by the adapter. The attach callback receives the adapter session and must load by id whatever it writes there; it must not mutate the caller's ORM objects. The callback runs under the authority's enforced guard: no commit/rollback/begin/savepoint, no second connection, no outbound transport, no other Revision, no booked ThreadRevision outside the booked slot.
